HOLD · LIFT · FIRE

Click left / right or press A / D to fire. Space fires both guns. Both charge automatically: wait longer for more damage.

Keep a finger gun in view to charge. Flick upward to fire, then lower it to charge again. Targets lock automatically; no hand aiming needed.

About 1 second gives 2 damage; 2 seconds gives a full 3-damage shot. Regular plants scale up to 5 health. Clear ten waves, the flower boss and the Thorn Queen with 5 hearts to win.

Keep your hands comfortably apart. Brief occlusions preserve charge; a longer absence pauses play. Holding a raised finger does not fire repeatedly.

Camera frames are never recorded or uploaded. The first model download needs internet access. Leaving stops the camera.
